description: No clean concept found. It fires mostly in the early middlegame (about 4-14 stones), and more often when the opponent's last stone went into column 2 above the bottom row. It is a graded sum over many stones: my stones low in column 3 and at the bottom of column 5 raise it, the opponent's stone at the bottom of column 3 strongly lowers it. Most early positions do not fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.03.
notes: 4 dev calls. Best F1 0.152 (AUROC 0.57, sim share 0.07) from ply<=14 + last move col 2 row>=1. Additive cell scores (F1 0.09-0.15, AUROC <=0.60) and a 'their last stone capped mine in cols 2-4' rule (F1 0.10) did no better. Activation depends on the board, not much on move order, and is additive with mixed-sign stone contributions. Every aggregate feature just tracks ply. Looks like a diffuse mixture or a random direction. Steer effect ~0. Synthesis reached 2.153, below the dev max of 2.216.
